newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ WEEKLY MOVEMENT RISES TO 4.691 MLN GALLONS.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ WEEKLY MOVEMENT RISES TO 4.691 MLN GALLONS.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended August 2 was 4,691,041 gallons compared with 4,484,597 gallons last week.
Imports were 368,092 gallons compared with 277,722 gallons the previous week. There were 66,704 domestic receipts this week compared with none the previous week.
Retail movement was 840,417 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,325,558 gallons.
The net cumulative pack for the season is 242,268,243 gallons. ((--New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1640))
